purpose: Production catalog alias/bundle and ProviderConvertible adapter, static import, declaration completeness and trust metadata

finalV1Followup.description: Final schema-v1 manifest validation and unknown-catalog publication guard added after the main regression run; both versions reran the custom-catalog and unknown-catalog cases, each including schema v1 export. The final default run includes two new v1 static tests and the invalid-policy regression.

reviewBypassFix.description: Contract-driven catalog validation and trust gating; legacy adapters cannot downgrade a catalog contract. Earlier full native runs predate this fix.
reviewBypassFix.redGreen: Empty entries with omitted TOML input reproduced before fix; passed after fix.

nativeFollowup.scope: C1a compatibility, catalog library/bundle and ProviderConvertible

realGradleAssertions: Groovy and Kotlin library/bundle helpers return both physical source paths
Equal bundle members retain separate declaration IDs and exact group membership
Consumer catalog policy disabled withholds declarations and retains relations
Reversing contexts preserves provenance and declared_in
Generated and explicit public ProviderConvertible delegates normally
Noncatalog Convertible works with a stable C1b contract without catalog trust
Custom TOML version.ref overridden in settings preserves effective version and correct sources
Missing Provider stability policy or catalog scope suppresses declaration evidence
Unsupported shape, mutation, copy and partial Action failure suppress partial lists
Unregistered catalog withholds graph metadata; schema v1 export refuses it without overwriting companion
Evaluation/task input changes, absent input generation, unsafe paths, duplicate JSON keys, symlinks and excessive members reject export
Schema v1 retains custom input hashes; static reader validates its catalog manifest and TOML
staticAssertions: Group owner, source, alias, member IDs, module multiset, kind, form and callback counts are independently recomputed
Malformed, stale or missing catalog input evidence withholds graph adoption but does not by itself lower lock vulnerability coverage
Unknown catalog trust settings stay disabled with a startup warning and fixed process policy
Existing C1a/C1b and unknown-adapter behavior remain covered

postReviewRevision.change: Verified catalog inputs whose content the static reader does not model (bundle over 128 members, version or bundle member defined outside the TOML, bundleMembers disagreeing with the TOML, catalog work budget) now keep graph relations and introduced_by and omit only declared_in with reason unsupported_catalog_model. TOML that does not parse, stale or uncaptured inputs and inventory mismatches still withhold graph metadata, including when an earlier catalog is unsupported.

liveHarnessRerun.note: Supported catalogs only; all harness assertions passed after the revision

verification.gradle8130MemberBundle: Native Gradle 8.11.1 accepts and resolves a 130-member bundle
